subject: How to set the timer
body: I read the manual, but I cannot work out how to set the start time on the timer.

subject: Water leaks from the spout
body: Water drips from the base of the spout when I pour and wets the table.

subject: The box arrived crushed
body: The corner of the outer box was crushed on arrival. The kettle itself has no scratch.

subject: Buying a spare inner pot
body: I want to buy only a new inner pot. What is the part number?

subject: The timer does not work as shown
body: I set the timer, but the rice is ready at a different time from the display. I cannot find where the manual explains it.

subject: Delivery later than planned
body: It did not arrive on the day I chose, and came two days late.

subject: Water seeps from the spout gap
body: When it is full, water seeps from the gap at the spout.

subject: Checking the warranty
body: I want to know how many years the warranty lasts.
